description:
FILED s464aw as the measured residue of #972.  Two small `use overload'
rules that #972 deliberately left, both probed 5.40.3.

=== (a) THE `=' COPY CONSTRUCTOR IS NEVER CONSULTED ===

perl copies the object before running a MUTATOR handler when the place is
SHARED, and refuses when the class has no `=' key:

    package Cmpd; use overload q/|/=>sub{"OR"}, q/|=/=>sub{"ORASSIGN"},
                               q(0+)=>sub{42}, q("")=>sub{"C"};
    my $a = Cmpd->new; my $z = $a; $z |= 3;
        perl: DIES `Operation "=": no method found, argument in overloaded
              package Cmpd'
        PCL : 43

    # with `q/=/ => sub { my $s=shift; bless [@$s], ref $s }' added:
        perl: ORASSIGN     PCL: 43

PCL has no `=' handling at all and no notion of a shared overloaded place, so
neither the copy nor the refusal happens.  This is entangled with #1001(b)
(the dedicated compound key) -- do them together, or (a) is unobservable.

=== (b) `fallback => 0' FORBIDS `.'-FROM-`""' ===

`.' and `x' are the two binary ops perl AUTOGENERATES from `""', and
`fallback => 0' forbids autogeneration outright, so such a class reaches
`nomethod' (or dies) for `.' although it HAS a `""' handler:

    package A3; use overload q(0+)=>sub{7}, q("")=>sub{"A3"}, fallback=>0,
                             nomethod=>sub{"N[$_[3]]"};
    $x . "z"    perl N[.]    PCL A3z

#972 marks `p-.''s `%with-binary-overload' call `:autogenerated t'
UNCONDITIONALLY, so nomethod never sees it.  Making it conditional means
asking `%p-overload-fallback-of' (an @ISA walk) on EVERY concat with an
object operand, which is the `""'-overload hot path -- version.pm and
Text::CSV_PP both live there.  MEASURED EXPOSURE BEFORE DECLINING: `nomethod'
appears in ZERO of the 25 files that say `use overload' across cpan-tests/ +
lib/ + perl-tests/, and in perl's own t/ only in `t/lib/overload_nomethod.t',
which the companion does not run (it scans op/ io/ re/ uni/ mro/ â¦ not
lib/).  So this row cannot fire anywhere PCL is measured today.

IF FIXED: gate the fallback walk on a `nomethod' handler actually being
present, and bench the `""'-overload concat loop before and after.

BAR: the rows above vs perl; the sweep; guards in Pl/t/overload-01.t (the
existing `fallback => 0 forbids the conversion derivation' row is the
sibling).
subject: the `=` (copy constructor) key is never consulted, and `fallback => 0` should forbid the `.`-from-`""` autogeneration
